Amenities include fishing pier, splash pad, picnic area, playground, and boat launch

services.name: Marina Bowfishing Experience
services.desc: SEP 11 - 8 pm Keesler Marina Ready for a unique night out? Join us for a sunset bowfishing trip at the Marina piers! All the gear you need is included, and our friendly guide will show you the ropes with easy safety tips and hands-on help. No experience? No problem-this is perfect for first-timers and seasoned bowfishers alike. Each trip is limited to just 4 people, so you’ll have plenty of space and personal attention. Space is limited, so make sure you register today. Open to all with base access and sponsored guests Ages - 12+ $50 - Per Person Register by September 9 Share your feedback about this facility through the Interactive Customer Evaluation (ICE) Website. services.name: Deer Island Kayak Adventure
services.desc: SEP 12 - 9 am Schooner Pier Boat Ramp, Biloxi Ready to paddle out and explore? The Deer Island Kayak Adventure is waiting! Spots fill up quickly, so book your trip and get ready for a day on the water you won’t forget. A sack lunch included. This trip is suitable for beginner and experienced kayakers. Kayaks, paddles, safety equipment, and transportation are provided. Don’t forget your camera for amazing views. Open to all with base access and sponsored guests Ages - 12 + $20 - Per Person Register by September 9 Share your feedback about this facility through the Interactive Customer Evaluation (ICE) Website.
